answer: Cheap throwaway identities cannot fake that depth, so farming accounts costs real stake per node. Sybil resistance here uses a bonded-proof stake: each agent must lock a refundable deposit tied to a slow, costly attestation trail, like carving a path through a canyon where every step is recorded. Peers cross-check the trail against a shared registry, a reef of verified history no copycat can clone. The sable thread binding it all is reputation earned only through sustained, audited work. From sa0016's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
